exercises.name: Bent-knee table row
exercises.rationale: Shoulder extension + scapular retraction (upper back, rear delt) and elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Trunk bracing is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Straight-leg table row
exercises.rationale: Shoulder extension + scapular retraction (upper back, rear delt) and elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Trunk bracing is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Feet-elevated table row
exercises.rationale: Shoulder extension + scapular retraction (upper back, rear delt) and elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Trunk bracing is isometric, so 0. Feet on a chair makes the body horizontal.

exercises.name: Band row
exercises.rationale: Shoulder extension + scapular retraction (upper back, rear delt) and elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Trunk bracing is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-up
exercises.rationale: Scapular depression/retraction only (upper back). Elbows stay straight, so biceps 0.

exercises.name: Negative pull-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder adduction/extension (lats, upper back) + elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Core is isometric, so 0. Eccentric only.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder adduction/extension (lats, upper back) + elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Core is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.rationale: Supinated grip puts the biceps in its strongest line of pull: shoulder extension (upper back) and elbow flexion (biceps) are both 1.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder adduction/extension (lats, upper back) + elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Core is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Archer pull-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder adduction/extension (lats, upper back) + elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Core is isometric, so 0. Working arm takes most of the load; logged per side.

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown
exercises.rationale: Shoulder adduction/extension (lats, upper back) + elbow flexion (biceps, secondary). Core is isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T raise
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal abduction / elevation (rear and side delt) + scapular retraction (upper back, secondary).

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal abduction (rear delt) + scapular retraction (upper back, secondary).

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.rationale: Horizontal abduction with external rotation: rear delts, mid back assists.

exercises.name: Band straight-arm pulldown
exercises.rationale: Shoulder extension with straight arms: lats without the biceps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
exercises.rationale: Rowing from a hip hinge: back and biceps pull, lower back and hamstrings hold the hinge.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.rationale: Supported one-arm row: back and biceps without the lower-back demand of a free hinge.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.rationale: Lying face down on an incline bench: strict row, no trunk work.

exercises.name: Renegade row
exercises.rationale: Row from a plank on dumbbells: back pulls while the core resists rotation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.rationale: Shoulder extension from overhead: lats and chest, loaded hardest at the stretched overhead position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse fly
exercises.rationale: Horizontal abduction bent over: rear delts, mid back assists.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.rationale: Scapular elevation: upper traps, counted under upper_back for the stress model.
